title: A constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on a limit of qcqs schemes descends to some stage (Stacks 09YU (3), essential surjectivity)
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(X_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ whose transition morphisms $f_{ii'}:X_i\to X_{i'}$ ($i\ge i'$) are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], every $X_i$ being quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]; let $X=\varprojlim_iX_i$ be its limit, with projections $f_i:X\to X_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $\mathcal F$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], an object of $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then there are an index $i\in I$, a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules $\mathcal F_i$ on $(X_i)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and an isomorphism of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules $f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i\cong\mathcal F$, where $f_i^{-1}$ is the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. (This is the essential surjectivity half of Stacks, Lemma 09YU (3): 'the category of constructible sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ is the colimit of the categories of constructible sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $(X_i)_{\Et}$', there for a Noetherian ring $\Lambda$; it is stated here for finite $\Lambda$, the generality of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. The faithfulness and full faithfulness halves of 09YU are not part of this statement, but the source's proof of essential surjectivity uses full faithfulness to descend the map between two presentations.)

source.place: Lemma 09YU (lemma-category-is-colimit) (3), etale-cohomology.tex lines 12551-12568; proof: paragraph 'Essentially surjective' for sheaves of sets (lines 12607-12619: via Lemma 09Y9 (lemma-category-constructible-sets), the faithful and fully faithful parts (the latter via Theorem 09YQ), Limits 01ZM (descend-finite-presentation) and 07RP (descend-etale)) and 'Proof of (3). The argument is very similar ... using Lemma 095N (lemma-category-constructible-modules) instead of Lemma 09Y9. Details omitted.' (lines 12621-12625)

proof.text: *Notation; $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated.* The projection $f_0:X\to X_0$ is affine [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition] (for any $0\in I$; $I$ is nonempty, being directed), hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence](3); as $X_0$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so is $X$ [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](2), [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For a scheme $S$ and an object $W$ of $S_{\Et}$ write $j_{W!}\Lambda_W$ for the sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the presheaf of $\Lambda_S$-modules $\Lambda_S[h_W]:V\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\mathrm{Mor}(V,W)}\Lambda_S(V)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module], and $\epsilon_{\mathcal H}:\mathrm{Hom}(j_{W!}\Lambda_W,\mathcal H)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal H(W)$ for the bijection, natural in $\mathcal H\in\Mod(S_{\Et},\Lambda)$ ($\epsilon_{\mathcal H'}(w\circ\beta)=w_W(\epsilon_{\mathcal H}(\beta))$), composed of the universal property of sheafification and $\beta\mapsto\beta_W(e_{\mathrm{id}_W})$ of [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module]. So a morphism out of $j_{W!}\Lambda_W$ is determined by one section over $W$, and any section over $W$ defines one. An isomorphism $a:W\xrightarrow{\sim}W''$ in $S_{\Et}$ induces an isomorphism $j_{W!}\Lambda_W\cong j_{W''!}\Lambda_{W''}$ (composition with $a$ on the index sets $\mathrm{Mor}(V,W)\to\mathrm{Mor}(V,W'')$, then sheafification).

source.place: Lemma 09YU, proof of (1), paragraph 'Fully faithful' ('Mor(h_U,G)=G(U)' as recalled in the proof of 09Z4, lines 12514-12517); the qcqs property of X is implicit in Stacks

proof.text: *A presentation of $\mathcal F$* (Stacks: 'using Lemma 095N instead of Lemma 09Y9'). $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated (step 1), $\Lambda$ finite and $\mathcal F$ constructible, so by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-finite-presentation] there are objects $U_1,\dots,U_n$, $V_1,\dots,V_m$ of $X_{\Et}$ with affine underlying schemes and an exact sequence $\mathcal P_1\xrightarrow{f}\mathcal P_0\xrightarrow{g}\mathcal F\to0$ in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ with $\mathcal P_0=\bigoplus_{k=1}^nj_{U_k!}\Lambda_{U_k}$, $\mathcal P_1=\bigoplus_{j=1}^mj_{V_j!}\Lambda_{V_j}$; $g$ is a cokernel of $f$. Let $\iota_j$ be the coprojections of $\mathcal P_1$ and $t_j=\epsilon_{\mathcal P_0}(f\circ\iota_j)\in\mathcal P_0(V_j)$. By the universal property of the finite coproduct [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and step 1, $f$ is determined by $(t_1,\dots,t_m)$: a morphism $f':\mathcal P_1\to\mathcal P_0$ with $\epsilon_{\mathcal P_0}(f'\iota_j)=t_j$ for all $j$ equals $f$.

source.place: Lemma 09YU, proof of (3), lines 12621-12625 ('using Lemma 095N instead of 09Y9'); Lemma 095N (lemma-category-constructible-modules), lines 12411-12425

proof.text: *Descending the objects $U_k$, $V_j$ to one stage* (Stacks: 'Limits, Lemmas 01ZM and 07RP'). By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-colimit](2) each $U_k$ (resp. $V_j$) is isomorphic over $X$ to $U_{k,i_k}\times_{X_{i_k}}X$ (resp. $V_{j,i'_j}\times_{X_{i'_j}}X$) for some index and some affine scheme etale over that stage. $I$ is directed and there are finitely many indices, so choose $0\in I$ above all of them; replacing $U_{k,i_k}$ by its base change $U_{k,0}=U_{k,i_k}\times_{X_{i_k}}X_0$, which is affine and etale over $X_0$, and using the canonical isomorphism of iterated fibre products $U_{k,0}\times_{X_0}X\cong U_{k,i_k}\times_{X_{i_k}}X$ ([lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-colimit](1): $u_0\circ u_{0i_k}\cong u_{i_k}$), and likewise for the $V_j$, we get affine objects $U_{k,0}$, $V_{j,0}$ of $(X_0)_{\Et}$ and isomorphisms $U_k\cong U_{k,0}\times_{X_0}X$, $V_j\cong V_{j,0}\times_{X_0}X$ in $X_{\Et}$. By step 1 these isomorphisms induce isomorphisms of the summands $j_{U_k!}\Lambda_{U_k}$, $j_{V_j!}\Lambda_{V_j}$; transporting $f$ and $g$ along them gives a presentation of $\mathcal F$ of the same form, so we may and do assume $U_k=U_{k,0}\times_{X_0}X$ and $V_j=V_{j,0}\times_{X_0}X$. The subset $I_{\ge0}$ is cofinal in the directed set $I$, so $X$ with the $f_i$ ($i\ge0$) is also the limit of the system restricted to $I_{\ge0}$; from now on only indices $i\ge0$ occur. For $i\ge0$ put $V_{j,i}=V_{j,0}\times_{X_0}X_i$, an affine object of $(X_i)_{\Et}$ ([lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-colimit](1)), and note the canonical isomorphism $V_{j,i}\times_{X_i}X\cong V_j$ over $X$.

source.place: Lemma 09YU, proof of (1), paragraph 'Essentially surjective' (lines 12607-12619): 'U is the base change of a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme etale over X_i for some i ... Limits, Lemmas 01ZM and 07RP'

proof.text: *The pulled-back free sheaves.* Put $\mathcal Q_0=\bigoplus_{k=1}^nj_{U_{k,0}!}\Lambda_{U_{k,0}}$ in $\Mod((X_0)_{\Et},\Lambda)$ and, for $i\ge0$, $\mathcal Q_{1,i}=\bigoplus_{j=1}^mj_{V_{j,i}!}\Lambda_{V_{j,i}}$ in $\Mod((X_i)_{\Et},\Lambda)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-free-etale-module] applied to $h=f_0$ and $W=U_{k,0}$ (with $W'=U_k$) there are isomorphisms $\theta_k:f_0^{-1}j_{U_{k,0}!}\Lambda_{U_{k,0}}\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{U_k!}\Lambda_{U_k}$, and applied to $h=f_i$ and $W=V_{j,i}$ (with $W'=V_{j,i}\times_{X_i}X\cong V_j$, step 3) isomorphisms $\theta'_{j,i}:f_i^{-1}j_{V_{j,i}!}\Lambda_{V_{j,i}}\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{V_j!}\Lambda_{V_j}$, each with the compatibility on generating sections stated there. The inverse image of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules is additive and a left adjoint [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact](3), so it preserves finite direct sums; hence the $\theta_k$ (resp. $\theta'_{j,i}$) assemble to isomorphisms $\beta:f_0^{-1}\mathcal Q_0\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal P_0$ and $\gamma_i:f_i^{-1}\mathcal Q_{1,i}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal P_1$ with $\beta\circ f_0^{-1}(\iota_k)=\iota_k\circ\theta_k$ and $\gamma_i\circ f_i^{-1}(\iota_j)=\iota_j\circ\theta'_{j,i}$.

source.place: Lemma 03S6 (lemma-shriek-base-change), lines 11492-11514; the module case of 09YU, whose details Stacks omits (line 12625)

proof.text: *Descending the map: the sections $t_j$* (Stacks: 'using the results of the previous two paragraphs', i.e. full faithfulness via Theorem 09YQ). Let $\mathcal G_i=f_{i0}^{-1}\mathcal Q_0$ ($i\ge0$) and $\mathcal G_\infty=f_0^{-1}\mathcal Q_0$, with the maps $\rho_{i'i}$, $\rho_i$ of [lem-weil-pbc-limit-pullback-sections-colimit] for $\mathcal G=\mathcal Q_0$ and $V_0=V_{j,0}$ (affine, etale over $X_0$; $X_i$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated, transition maps affine). Let $t'_j\in\mathcal G_\infty(V_j)$ be the image of $t_j$ under $\beta^{-1}$ (step 4), $V_j=V_{j,0}\times_{X_0}X$. By that lemma $t'_j=\rho_{i_j}(s'_j)$ for some $i_j\ge0$ and $s'_j\in\mathcal G_{i_j}(V_{j,i_j})$. Choose $i\ge i_1,\dots,i_m$ and put $s_j=\rho_{ii_j}(s'_j)\in\mathcal G_i(V_{j,i})$; by the compatibility $\rho_i\circ\rho_{ii_j}=\rho_{i_j}$ of the same lemma, $\rho_i(s_j)=t'_j$ for $j=1,\dots,m$.

source.place: Lemma 09YU, proof of (1), paragraphs 'Fully faithful' (lines 12589-12605) and 'Essentially surjective' (lines 12607-12619); Theorem 09YQ (theorem-colimit), lines 7400-7411

proof.text: *The descended presentation map and its pullback.* Let $\varphi_i:\mathcal Q_{1,i}\to\mathcal G_i=f_{i0}^{-1}\mathcal Q_0$ be the morphism of $\Mod((X_i)_{\Et},\Lambda)$ with $\epsilon_{\mathcal G_i}(\varphi_i\circ\iota_j)=s_j$ for every $j$ (step 1 and the universal property of the finite coproduct [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]). Let $c:f_i^{-1}\mathcal G_i=f_i^{-1}f_{i0}^{-1}\mathcal Q_0\xrightarrow{\sim}f_0^{-1}\mathcal Q_0$ be the composition isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition](2) ($f_0=f_{i0}\circ f_i$); it is $\Lambda$-linear, since it is characterized by the units of the adjunctions, which are $\Lambda$-linear [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-module-adjunction]. Claim: $\beta\circ c\circ f_i^{-1}(\varphi_i)\circ\gamma_i^{-1}=f$. By step 2 it suffices to compare $\epsilon_{\mathcal P_0}$ of both sides composed with $\iota_j$. By step 4, $\gamma_i^{-1}\circ\iota_j=f_i^{-1}(\iota_j)\circ\theta'^{-1}_{j,i}$, so the left side composed with $\iota_j$ is $\beta\circ c\circ f_i^{-1}(\varphi_i\iota_j)\circ\theta'^{-1}_{j,i}$. By the compatibility clause of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-free-etale-module] (with $\mathcal H=\mathcal G_i$, $s=s_j$, $\varphi_s=\varphi_i\iota_j$), $\epsilon_{f_i^{-1}\mathcal G_i}(f_i^{-1}(\varphi_i\iota_j)\circ\theta'^{-1}_{j,i})$ is the image $\eta(s_j)$ of $s_j$ under the unit of $f_i^{-1}\dashv f_{i,*}$, a section of $f_i^{-1}\mathcal G_i$ over $V_{j,i}\times_{X_i}X=V_j$. By naturality of $\epsilon$, applying $c$ then $\beta$ gives $\epsilon_{\mathcal P_0}$ of the composite: $\beta(c(\eta(s_j)))$; and $c(\eta(s_j))$, read over $V_j$ through the canonical isomorphism, is by definition $\rho_i(s_j)=t'_j$ ([lem-weil-pbc-limit-pullback-sections-colimit]); finally $\beta(t'_j)=t_j=\epsilon_{\mathcal P_0}(f\iota_j)$ (step 2, step 5). This proves the claim: the square formed by $f_i^{-1}(\varphi_i)$, $f$ and the isomorphisms $\gamma_i$, $\beta\circ c$ commutes.

source.place: Lemma 09YU, proof of (1), paragraph 'Fully faithful' (lines 12589-12605), adapted to sheaves of modules as Stacks instructs for (3) (lines 12621-12625; details omitted there)

proof.text: *The descended sheaf $\mathcal F_i$ and its constructibility.* $\Mod((X_i)_{\Et},\Lambda)$ is abelian, cokernels being the sheafifications of the sectionwise cokernels [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; let $\mathcal F_i=\mathrm{Coker}(\varphi_i)$. The schemes $V_{j,i}$ and $U_{k,0}$ are affine, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and etale over the quasi-compact quasi-separated $X_i$, $X_0$; $\Lambda$ is a finite $\Lambda$-module; so every $j_{V_{j,i}!}\Lambda_{V_{j,i}}$ and every $j_{U_{k,0}!}\Lambda_{U_{k,0}}$ is constructible [lem-weil-pbc-etale-free-sheaf-constructible] (its sheaf $j_!\underline\Lambda_U$ is by definition the sheafification of $\Lambda[h_U]$). Constructible sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules are closed under extensions and cokernels [thm-constructible-serre]; a finite direct sum $\mathcal A\oplus\mathcal B$ is an extension $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal A\oplus\mathcal B\to\mathcal B\to0$, so by induction $\mathcal Q_{1,i}$ and $\mathcal Q_0$ are constructible (the empty sum is the zero sheaf, constructible with the one-stratum stratification $\{X_i\}$, on which it is constant with value the finite module $0$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]). The inverse image $\mathcal G_i=f_{i0}^{-1}\mathcal Q_0$ of a constructible sheaf is constructible [prop-constructible-pullback]. Hence $\mathcal F_i$, the cokernel of a morphism between constructible sheaves, is a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $(X_i)_{\Et}$ [thm-constructible-serre].

source.place: Lemma 095N, proof, first sentence (lines 12428-12431: 'modules of this form are constructible', via Lemmas 03S8 (lemma-jshriek-constructible) and 03RZ (lemma-constructible-abelian)); Lemma 09BH proof (3), lines 12251-12267

proof.text: *Conclusion.* The inverse image $f_i^{-1}$ on sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules is exact, in particular preserves cokernels [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact](3), so $f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i$ is a cokernel of $f_i^{-1}(\varphi_i):f_i^{-1}\mathcal Q_{1,i}\to f_i^{-1}\mathcal G_i$. By step 6 the morphisms $f_i^{-1}(\varphi_i)$ and $f$ are isomorphic as arrows (via the isomorphisms $\gamma_i$ and $\beta\circ c$), so their cokernels are isomorphic; and $\mathcal F$, with $g$, is a cokernel of $f$ (step 2). Hence $f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i\cong\mathcal F$ as sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules, with $\mathcal F_i$ constructible on $(X_i)_{\Et}$ (step 7), which is the statement.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks 09YU (etale-cohomology.tex 12551-12625: the sets proof and 'details omitted' for modules), 095N, 03S8/03RZ, 09YQ, 03S6 and the existing nodes. Statement kept. Proof written out (by agent, Stacks omits the module case) in 8 steps following the sets proof: X qcqs and the Hom(j_{W!}Lambda_W,H)=H(W) bijection (free Yoneda leaf + sheafification); presentation of F (lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-finite-presentation, 095N); descent of the affine etale U_k, V_j to one stage via lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-colimit (2) (which packages 01ZM + 07RP; the brief's 01ZM/07RP route is that node's own proof); pullback of the free sheaves (new node lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-free-etale-module, Stacks 03S6 for Lambda_W with the generating-section compatibility) and finite sums (prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact (3)); descent of the matrix of the presentation map through its sections t_j in P_0(V_j) (new node lem-weil-pbc-limit-pullback-sections-colimit, 09YQ in degree 0 as in the 'Fully faithful' paragraph; only its surjectivity and compatibility are used, faithfulness of 09YU is not needed); verification that the descended map pulls back to f (inverse-image-composition, linear by the module adjunction); constructibility of the cokernel F_i (lem-weil-pbc-etale-free-sheaf-constructible, thm-constructible-serre for extensions/cokernels, prop-constructible-pullback); right exactness of f_i^{-1}. Mathlib: no match (one more LeanSearch recorded); both new nodes searched with LeanSearch, LeanFinder/Loogle and grep, no match (Mathlib's PresheafOfModules pullback of free Yoneda objects, Presheaf/Pullback.lean:70, is the presheaf-level analogue of the new 03S6 node).
